# RTL paragraph fixtures

All books here are original deterministic test content under the repository MIT
license, generated by `python tests/rtl_verify.py generate tests/fixtures/rtl`.

The corpus is `arabic-journey.epub`, `arabic-library.epub` and
`hebrew-journey.epub`. Each has two reading-order chapters and a nonlinear nav
resource. Scenarios include paragraph direction, ASCII digits/decimals, brackets,
guillemets, straight/curly quotes, Latin phrases, justified paragraphs spanning
pages, first-line indentation and an explicitly LTR paragraph inside an RTL book.

`native-*` are focused variants consumed by the five native RTL CTest groups.
`progression-*` exercise explicit LTR precedence and absent/default/invalid
progression with language fallback, including case-insensitive region subtags.
The generated book text is not presented as a published Arabic/Hebrew work.

The downloaded Gutenberg book and the labelled derivative with a controlled test
appendix stay in `build/rtl-corpus/`. Their source and content hashes, original
versus derived distinction, screenshots and measured results are recorded in
`tests/rtl-verify-20261109/REPORT.md`.
